title: Experimental Measurement and Theoretical Analysis of Energy Relaxation Rates of an Interacting Two-Qubit System on a D-Wave Quantum Annealer
summary: In D-Wave quantum annealers, various properties of the ground state have been clarified, whereas the correspondence between theory and experiment for energy relaxation rates in multiqubit excited states remains insufficiently understood. Here, we measured the energy relaxation rates of the first excited states in single-qubit systems and interacting two-qubit systems using a D-Wave quantum annealer.
